title: 18 January 1963: Live: Floral Hall Ballroom, Morecambe
content:
The Beatles’ second and final performance at the Floral Hall Ballroom in Morecambe took place on 18 January 1963. The first had taken place on 29 August 1962.

The group’s road manager, Neil Aspinall, was unwell with the flu on this day, so Les Hurst, Gerry and the Pacemakers’ roadie, stood in for him.
